content: I found you can screw the top nut in 2-3 turns and it catches on the frame. Then you can put the tool inside, line it up and then with one hand screw it in. Works much better if you have a screwdriver rather than an allen key.
I sort of held the spool holder in place with my knee so that my hands were free to hold the assembly tool and the screwdriver lol. Guess get to stretching lol.

I tipped the printer on to its side - makes installing the bottom holders much simpler.

Also took the opportunity to replace the terrible feet with screw-in ones, I used pre-existing threaded holes.

What a nightmare. 

I hope these changes are future proof because there is no way in hell I'm going to remove these in order to do any upgrades.

This was just horrible. How does the tool just float there on the photos?I has to hold mine.

Tip: Screw the screw through the chassis into the tool to keep it in place. The screw one half of the puck holder upside down. Remove holder screw, turn puck to correct side and screw second screw.
